question: By what seed-mantra is the six-limb nyāsa declared to be performed?
premises: The six-limb nyāsa is the ritual act in question.
It is declared to use the six-long-moon seed.
inference: The six-limb nyāsa is to be performed with the six-long-moon bīja.
uncertainties: The precise syllabic expansion of ṣaḍdīrghacandrabīja is not specified here.
plain_english: The six-limb nyāsa is declared to be done with the six-long-moon seed.
